author: kycrafft
body:
First things first remove steak. 

Now that we go that over with, it would be nice to add some things. 

[Traps]
-Green carpet; gives 4 seconds of poison to anyone within 4 blocks when stepped on
-Black carpet; same as green but with 6 seconds of either 
-Grey carpet; same as the others but slowness for 10 seconds
-Stone pressure plate; explosion, 4 hearts of damage to anyone within 4 blocks

I believe this is Legosean's old idea, credit goes to him for thinking of using carpets for potion effects. These can be bought in the shop for yourself but not for your team. Also adding 2 stone pressure plates to engineer would be cool

Green, Black, Grey carpet: 4 points for 1, 
Stone pressure plate: 5 points for 1

More potions in the shop would be nice: 

Speed 1 potion (2:15 minutes, splash): 5 points for 1, 11 for team
regen 1 potion (45 seconds, splash) 6 points for 1, 12 for team
instant damage 1 potion (splash Ofc)  4 points for 1, 9 for team
Jumb boost 2 potion (1:39 minutes) 4 points for1, 9 for team (thanks Davidan)

Thats all I really have as of now; its kind of a short list


*Traps cannot be set off or hurt your team. They cannot be set off by you but they CAN hurt you.

title: [Sug] Nexus (shop) improvements

replies.author: rot43
replies.body: I don't know, the potions sound good but with the carpets, I feel like it would modify the game too much, nexus feels like a gamemode made mainly for a basic TDM style, and even with the different amounts of kits and jumbled abilities, I think this would just make it too chaotic, and less of that classic nebula feel.
